# Overview of workflow outputs {#sec-outputs}

To preserve a clean separation between **analytical documentation** (this Quarto book in `docs-src/`) and **data-product generation**, all computationally intensive spatial outputs are produced by standalone, reproducible R scripts stored in `scripts/` and written to dedicated subfolders under `results/`. Each output package is documented with Frictionless Data Package schemas (`datapackage.json`), Zenodo deposit metadata (`.zenodo.json`), and a dynamically rendered `README.qmd` before deposition on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org).

@fig-outputs illustrates how TASVEG 5.0 spatial polygons and multi-interpreter membership tables feed into the three core state-level outputs.

```{dot}
//| label: fig-outputs
//| fig-cap: "Relationship between TASVEG 5.0 inputs, multi-interpreter membership tables/matrices, and the three core state-level outputs."
//| file: ../fig/TASVEG-outputs.dot
//| fig-height: 7
//| fig-width: 7
```

## Status summary of workflow outputs

The table below summarises the current release status of all core and derived outputs generated by the `TASVEG-XREF` workflow. Currently, **Output 3 (90 m Best-Candidate Spatial Synthesis)** is published on Zenodo (under embargo until `2027-06-01`), while the remaining core and single-EFG derived outputs are in draft or active development.

| Output | Description & Key Files | Folder & Script | Status | Reference / DOI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Output 1: Spatial Vector & Membership Matrices Bundle** | Dissolved statewide GeoPackage (`TASVEG-xref-IUCN-GET-best.gpkg`), 5 per-interpreter CSV membership matrices, and QGIS `.qml` styles | `results/TASVEG-vector-bundle/` (`scripts/TASVEG-membership-matrices.R`) | **In development** (spatial/tabular files generated; packaging metadata & README pending) | *Pending* |
| **Output 2: 90 m EFG Membership Rasters** | 31 continuous 90 m GeoTIFFs (`prop_memb` for every candidate Round 2 EFG) + summary CSV, `.zenodo.json`, `datapackage.json`, `README.qmd` | `results/efg-membership-rasters/` (`scripts/EFG-membership-raster.R`) | **Draft** (data & Zenodo metadata prepared; pending Zenodo upload) | *Pending* |
| **Output 3: 90 m Best-Candidate Spatial Synthesis** | 3 aligned 90 m GeoTIFFs (`target`, `membership`, `supporting`), 2 lookup/synthesis CSVs, `.qml`/`.clr` styles, `datapackage.json`, `README.md` | `results/best-candidate/` (`scripts/TASVEG-xref-IUCNGET-output-best-90m.R`) | **Published on Zenodo** (v0.1.0; embargoed until 2027-06-01) | @OUTPUT1_best_candidate [![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.24034201.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24034201) |
| **Derived Output: TF1.7 (*Boreal and temperate fens*) Vector** | Polygon GeoPackage (`9,868` polygons across 6 `VEGCODE`s with all 5 interpreter columns & consensus metrics), unit summary CSV, `.qml`, `.zenodo.json`, `datapackage.json`, `README.qmd` | `results/efg-TF1.7-vector/` (`scripts/EFG-membership-vector.R --args TF1.7`) | **Draft** (data & Zenodo metadata prepared; pending Zenodo upload) | *Pending* |
| **Derived Output: TF1.6 (*Boreal, temperate and montane peat bogs*) Vector** | Polygon GeoPackage and unit-level area/membership summary CSV for all TASVEG communities linked to `TF1.6` | `results/efg-TF1.6-vector/` (`scripts/EFG-membership-vector.R --args TF1.6`) | **In development** (GeoPackage & summary CSV generated; style & Zenodo metadata pending) | *Pending* |

## Core state-level outputs

### Output 1: Spatial data + membership matrices *(In development)*

This bundle preserves the full polygon geometry (dissolved by `VEGCODE` into a GeoPackage) alongside five full-width per-interpreter CSV membership matrices formatted for integration with national-scale cross-referencing collections. Expand the block below to inspect the standalone generation script (`scripts/TASVEG-membership-matrices.R`):

```{r}
#| filename: "scripts/TASVEG-membership-matrices.R"
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Workflow for vector bundle and per-interpreter membership matrices"
#| file: ../../scripts/TASVEG-membership-matrices.R
```

### Output 2: EFG membership raster layers *(Draft)*

Unlike the categorical best-candidate layer, this 31-layer 90 m GeoTIFF stack retains continuous aggregated fuzzy membership (`prop_memb`) for **every** candidate IUCN GET Ecosystem Functional Group assigned positive weight in Round 2 (including 10 secondary EFGs that never appear as a single best candidate). This enables continuous spatial uncertainty propagation and weighted extent calculations. Expand the blocks below to inspect the generation script and Zenodo README template:

```{r}
#| filename: "scripts/EFG-membership-raster.R"
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Workflow for 31 per-EFG 90 m membership raster layers"
#| file: ../../scripts/EFG-membership-raster.R
```

```{r}

#| eval: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Draft README template for Output 2 (EFG membership rasters)"
#| file: ../../results/efg-membership-rasters/README.qmd
```

### Output 3: Best-candidate spatial synthesis *(Published on Zenodo)*

The standalone workflow for *Cross-referencing Tasmanian vegetation map (TASVEG 5.0) to the IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology: 90m Best-Candidate Spatial Synthesis* [@OUTPUT1_best_candidate] reproduces the three 90 m GeoTIFFs (`TASVEG-xref-target.tiff`, `TASVEG-xref-membership.tiff`, `TASVEG-xref-supporting.tiff`), tabular CSV dictionaries, and GIS colour maps from scratch:

```{r}
#| filename: "scripts/TASVEG-xref-IUCNGET-output-best-90m.R"
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Workflow for raster outputs (best candidate)"
#| file: ../../scripts/TASVEG-xref-IUCNGET-output-best-90m.R
```

The Quarto template below dynamically inspects the generated rasters and CSVs to render the dataset's Zenodo `README.md` and keep `TASVEG-xref-target.qml` synchronised:

## Derived single-EFG vector outputs

Using the parameterised script `scripts/EFG-membership-vector.R` (invoked with `--args <EFG_CODE>`), we can extract polygon-level GeoPackage datasets for individual Ecosystem Functional Groups of targeted conservation or Red List of Ecosystems interest, preserving all five individual interpreter membership columns alongside the aggregated synthesis metrics:

```{r}
#| filename: "scripts/EFG-membership-vector.R"
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Parameterised workflow for single-EFG polygon vector extraction"
#| file: ../../scripts/EFG-membership-vector.R
```

### TF1.7 *Boreal and temperate fens* of Tasmania *(Draft)*

Generated via `R --vanilla --file="scripts/EFG-membership-vector.R" --args TF1.7`, this draft package (`results/efg-TF1.7-vector/`) extracts all 9,868 TASVEG 5.0 polygons across six communities (`AAP`, `AHL`, `HCM`, `HSE`, `HSW`, `MGH`) linked to `TF1.7` in Round 2, complete with QGIS styling, Frictionless Data schema, Zenodo metadata, and a dynamic README template:

```{r}
#| filename: "results/efg-TF1.7-vector/README.qmd"
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Draft README template for TF1.7 vector output"
#| file: ../../results/efg-TF1.7-vector/README.qmd
```

### TF1.6 *Boreal, temperate and montane peat bogs* of Tasmania *(In development)*

Generated via `R --vanilla --file="scripts/EFG-membership-vector.R" --args TF1.6`, this output (`results/efg-TF1.6-vector/`) currently includes the extracted polygon GeoPackage (`TASVEG-xref-TF1.6-memb.gpkg`) and unit-level area summary CSV (`TASVEG-xref-TF1.6-unit-summary.csv`), with QGIS styling and Zenodo packaging metadata pending.
